purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Wuppertal’s official Open Data page and catalog identify weekly updated ALKIS parcel polygons, approximately 100,000 parcels, under DL-Zero. The official NRW simplified ALKIS WFS advertises parcel features without owners; its schema exposes a safe parcel key and full MultiSurface geometry. A bounded exact-WUP-point query returned one full parcel polygon and key. This proves a point sample only, not citywide completeness or runtime readiness.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city page documents approximately 100,000 weekly updated ALKIS parcel polygons and DL-Zero licensing.
Official city data portal lists the ALKIS parcel dataset and GeoJSON/Atom distributions.
Official catalog API identifies the complete GeoJSON distribution and city-published Atom feed.
Official NRW WFS capabilities describe a direct-access download service for simplified ALKIS parcels without owner data.
Official schema exposes `flstkennz` and `geometrie`; only these two fields were requested.
Exact WUP-point GetFeature request returned one full parcel feature, with only `flstkennz` and `geometrie` requested.
